caption: The drawing depicts a single ornamental post primarily rendered in shades of gray and blue-gray, with intricate architectural detailing. At the top of the post is a sculpted horse's head, facing left, which is elevated above a decorative circular base that resembles leaves or petals. The column beneath the horse head features vertical fluting and central ring-like elements, with a wider, elaborately decorated midsection that includes raised floral or heraldic motifs. The base of the post is rounded and slightly flares outward. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, with some scattered orange-brown stains and four faint, rectangular marks near the corners, suggesting previous contact with another material. Handwritten notes are present at the lower right corner of the image.
title: Horse Head Hitching Post
